notes.pairing: BEFORE↔AFTER by app + inventory row (no) + route + width + theme + role; only status "rendered" on both sides is compared
notes.shell: Ruling Z: same rule|severity|kind|normalized text|width|theme|role on >= 5 distinct routes = one point ("shell": true) with routeCount/occurrences; routes lists the first 20
notes.new: totals.new = added + escalated (escalated = persisting whose severity rose; not counted again in persisting)
notes.persisting: counts per rule × severity × route × width × theme × role with up to 5 example texts (Ruling AC); per-finding detail stays in .tmp
notes.fontCheck: afterOnlyR8 = font-family check on AFTER only; never part of added/escalated/persisting/resolved (Ruling J)
notes.liff: LIFF rows (/liff*) use one synthetic customer session in both role runs → role "liff", counted once
notes.dedupe: inventory rows sharing a path are separate measurements (different entry point / fact counts); a finding is counted once per app + findingKey, and across rows escalated beats persisting and persisting/escalated beat added/resolved (totals.crossRowPrecedence = entries dropped)
notes.routesCounts: routes[].counts are per BEFORE/AFTER pair, before cross-row dedupe and precedence — their sums exceed totals by design
notes.houseStyle: totals.houseStyle: R3/R7 (persisting + new) under the house-style thresholds (owner decision 2026-11-08 — decision + thresholds inside); every count is a real finding, no house-style exemption is subtracted
notes.revisions: sources[].revision comes from the run folder run.json (revisionSource "run.json") or from --revision <label>=<sha> (revisionSource "cli"; the storefront runs have no run.json)
notes.runTokens: run-specific seed tokens (DOCS-<hex>, truncated "abcd1234..." ids) are canonicalized in the key text before pairing; displayed texts are raw
notes.noise: D1/D2 on /liff/debug excluded (run-specific port in the text) — totals.deltas.noiseExcluded
notes.text: texts clipped to 120 characters; synthetic harness/fixture data only
